definitions.scope: All 17 failed original-policy final episodes, selected solely by success=false in the complete 60-episode original reports; no other model outcomes used.
definitions.time: Zero-based action steps at 20 Hz. Gap measurements use pre-action diagnostics at the first close-run action. Contacts use the initial state plus every post-action diagnostic, with no duplicate intermediate states.
definitions.sustained_close: At least three consecutive applied_action[6] > 0.5, equivalent to at least 0.15 s of close commands at 20 Hz. This is a descriptive post-hoc command threshold, not proof that the fingers closed or grasped.
definitions.open: applied_action[6] < -0.5; a sustained open run also requires at least three consecutive actions. Intermediate is the inclusive interval [-0.5, 0.5].
definitions.xy_gap: Euclidean XY separation between end-effector reference position and cube centre, in metres; not a fingertip clearance or calibrated grasp-error threshold.
definitions.z_gap: Signed end-effector Z minus cube-centre Z, in metres; positive means end-effector reference above cube centre.
definitions.bilateral_contact: Recorded positive normal force on both finger pads.
definitions.firm_bilateral_grasp: Recorded normal force >=1.0 N on each finger pad, using the existing simulator diagnostic.
definitions.gripper_contact: Existing simulator any gripper-to-cube contact diagnostic; does not imply bilateral or firm contact.
definitions.lift: Existing criterion cube-centre Z >0.97 m; table Z is 0.9 m.

classifications.neverclosed: No qualifying sustained-close command run and no firm contact; does not mean no individual positive command or no finger motion.
classifications.closedwithoutfirmcontact: At least one qualifying sustained-close command run, but no recorded firm bilateral contact.
classifications.transientfirmcontactwithoutlift: Some recorded firm bilateral contact that is absent at the final state, without ever crossing the lift threshold.

definitions.command_patterns: All qualifying close/open runs are retained with inclusive zero-based endpoints; shorter or intermediate command segments are represented by action totals and transition counts. Complete raw applied commands remain in the hashed source traces.

checks: All expected failed seeds included exactly once; 600 ordered trace rows per failed episode.
Reported event indices match post-action diagnostics; reported peak cube heights match complete trace states within 1e-12 m.
First-close XY/Z diagnostics checked against recorded end-effector and cube coordinates.
Both manifests bind the unchanged final candidate lock; contact threshold and control rate verified.
limits: This post-hoc symptom analysis does not identify a causal controller error or establish that changing closure timing/position would improve outcomes.
Diagnostics sample control steps rather than every internal physics substep; brief inter-step contacts may be unobserved.
End-effector reference offsets are not fingertip/object surface distances; command thresholds do not directly measure finger closure.
No source code, policy, success criterion, evaluation plan or candidate selection was changed.
source_path_base: Paths in candidate_lock, source_reports and each episode trace/source_report are relative to the study directory (runs/improvement_20261011, or its extracted archive). Diagnostic-source file paths are repository-relative.
